systems.country_label: Censo Escolar; Anuario Estadístico de la Educación
systems.owner: Unidad de Estadística e Investigación, Dirección General de Planificación y Promoción Educativa, Ministry of Education; supported technically and financially by PRODEGE, which the government funds
systems.tiers: each public or private school reports by questionnaire; the district inspectorates follow up and pass it on; the central statistics unit processes, analyses and publishes; covers infantil y preescolar, primaria, secundaria and formación técnica profesional; 1,017 pre-primary schools reported in 2020-2021

systems.country_label: Sistema de Información y Mapa Escolar (SIME)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Dirección General de Planificación y Promoción Educativa
systems.tiers: central: gives education statistics and indicators at each geographic level and for each school through a school report (reporte escolar), from the census data

note: No fact: the yearbook describes the annual school census and SIME, which serves statistics drawn from it; the passages describe no entry by schools other than the yearly questionnaire. It says disability data come from schools' enrolment registers, without saying how those are kept.
